test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.

As a punishment for his __betrayal__ to his country, the spy who sold secrets was sent to prison.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"betrayal"** means the act of being disloyal or treacherous to someone or something. (विश्वासघात)

 
 
• **Example: **His** betrayal** of his best friend was unforgivable.
 
 
 
• **"Loyalty"** refers to the quality of being loyal and showing constant support or allegiance to someone or something. (निष्ठा)
 
 
• **Example: **Her** loyalty** to her family is evident in everything she does.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'betrayal'** is **'loyalty'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nasty** (घिनौना): Something that is very bad, unpleasant, or offensive.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather turned** nasty** as the storm approached.
 
 
 
• **Perilous** (खतरनाक): Full of danger or risk.
 
 
• **Example:** The journey through the desert was **perilous** and exhausting.
 
 
 
• **Infidelity** (विश्वासघात): The action or state of being unfaithful to a spouse or other partner.
 
 
• **Example:** **Infidelity** can destroy the trust in a relationship.
